newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Eravis buys 50 pct Hunguest Hotels stake.
newsitem.headline: Eravis buys 50 pct Hunguest Hotels stake.

text.p: Hungary's hotel chain Eravis Rt bought an 50 percent stake in hotel chain Hunguest Hotels Rt, which is owned by leisure company Hunguest Rt, Hungarian news agency MTI reported on Thursday.
Following the purchase of the stake, Eravis and Hunguest increased Hunguest Hotels' 850 million forint issued share capital to 2.07 billion forints with a 50-50 percent contribution, it said.
The capital increase will enable the refurbishment of Hunguest's hotels. Work is scheduled to start next year and is expected to be completed in five years.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, Eravis shares closed unchanged at 4,300 forints.
